subject: Post-demo security recap: request for IR timelines & SOC 2 evidence
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Cardenas <lisa@oscurahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 31 Oct 2026 17:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo security recap: request for IR timelines & SOC 2 evidence

Lisa — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap and requested next steps from our side so we can move toward procurement and the security review you mentioned. I've kept this concise so your security and procurement teams can action items directly.

Recap (from our call)
- Oscura evaluating for patient-facing workflows (HIPAA scope) and backup/restore SLA requirements.
- Your security team wants: SOC 2 attestation (latest report), incident response runbook / timeline template, and proof of BCP/DR exercises.
- Procurement will need a short vendor security questionnaire filled (we'll await the link).

Requested deliverables from Redwood (proposed):
1) SOC 2 status + snapshot (what we can share outside of NDA): high-level report summary + scope and date.
2) Incident response playbook excerpt: breach notification timeline, escalation matrix, escalation SLAs.
3) BCP/DR evidence: disaster recovery test summary (most recent tabletop date + results).
4) Point of contact for live walkthroughs (security / infra).

Proposed timeline:
- Can we commit to the SOC 2 snapshot + IR runbook excerpt by end of next week (Nov 6)?
- BCP/DR test summary by Nov 10.

Lisa, please confirm if the above covers what you need and whether we should route any of this to a legal-only channel (NDA) before sending artifacts. I've cc'd Marissa (security liasion) and Ben (sales engineering) to help assemble the items.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

—Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: none in this message
From: Lisa Cardenas <lisa@oscurahealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: security@oscurahealth.com, procurement@oscurahealth.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 10:21:34 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-demo security recap: request for IR timelines & SOC 2 evidence

Connor — great summary, thanks. A few clarifying notes from our side:

1) SOC 2: We need the Type II report for the last 12 months or at minimum a SOC 2 attestation letter and list of subservice orgs. If an NDA is required to share the full report, we can sign one, but the attestation snapshot helps speed internal review.
2) IR / Breach notification: We require an example timeline that shows discovery -> customer notification window (we typically require 72 hours for initial notification, but will consider vendor timelines).
3) BCP/DR: Summary is fine — date of last full DR test, summary of RTO/RPO, and any incident lessons learned.

I'm attaching our vendor questionnaire (scorecard) to this reply — it's compressed to the key fields we need to review. Can your team fill the attached matrix and return? We also flagged a couple of high-level HIPAA items for follow-up in the questionnaire.

We can provide an NDA template if needed — procurement@oscurahealth.com is cc'd. For now, a SOC 2 snapshot + IR timeline excerpt would let us move through initial security gating.

Thanks,
Lisa Cardenas
Head of Security Operations, Oscura Health
lisa@oscurahealth.com

Attachments: oscura_vendor_qa.xlsx (vendor security scorecard)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 08:03:12 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo security recap: request for IR timelines & SOC 2 evidence

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Lisa's reply and the attached questionnaire. Two asks:

1) Can Security (Marissa) produce a one-page SOC 2 snapshot we can safely share outside an NDA (high-level issuance date, scope, controls covered, auditor)? Please include the scope (data centers/hosting) and any subservice orgs. Also confirm redactions we should apply.

2) Ben — can you pull an excerpt of the IR runbook focused on detection -> customer notification (we need a clear timeline example showing detection -> containment -> assessment -> notification windows). If we can annotate with the names/roles (redacted as necessary) that will help Oscura follow our escalation matrix.

Proposed internal deadlines so we can stay on Lisa's timeline: SOC 2 snapshot & IR excerpt by EOD Nov 6; BCP/DR test summary by Nov 10. Oscura also asked for the questionnaire to be returned — I'll handle initial pass but we may need subject-matter answers from infra/security.

Looping in legal via this thread only if Marissa recommends (I'll hold on sending the SOC 2 full report until we have an NDA).

Onwards — Connor

Connor — thanks for the forward. Quick plan from Security:

- SOC 2 snapshot: I will generate a two-page shareable summary (control coverage, report period, auditor, scope) and call out any subservice orgs. We will mark any items that require NDA before full report release.
- IR runbook excerpt: I will extract the breach notification timeline and create a 1-page timeline graphic + a short escalation matrix (roles: incident commander, engineering lead, legal, customer comms).
- BCP/DR evidence: I can produce a one-page DR test summary (last full drill: 2026-06-18, RTO target 4h, RPO 15m) and list corrective actions from that drill.

Owners & OOOs: Ben will help pull operational specifics (service owners for RTO/RPO) and I'll coordinate with Legal if we need an NDA before sharing SOC 2 artifacts.

We'll aim to deliver these artifacts for Connor to send next Friday (Nov 6) as requested. I'll attach the files to this thread once ready.

Marissa Cole
Director, Information Security, Redwood Inference
